verdict.notes: Code-only local authority sufficient; no external provenance verification claimed. Most findings are supported or conditional. One unsupported minor shutdown assertion: repeat calls themselves are idempotent; no concrete concurrent-call failure shown. Static-only/no-tests limitations candidly reported. Keyed omissions concern completeness.
unsupported_gap_claims: `shutdown` isn't idempotent-safe against concurrent callers. — No failing interleaving of repeated shutdown is established: each assigns True then clears a dict, both repeatable. A possible shutdown/open race would require a different explicit mechanism and does not substantiate this particular assertion.
